transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?
I've been feeling extremely depressed, sad, and empty for about eight months now. It has been really hard to cope with these feelings every day. I just feel completely down and nothing seems to help.
Have you ever had a period of at least two months during these eight months when your mood felt back to normal, or has it been depressed כמעט every day the whole time?
No, I haven't had any periods where I felt back to normal. It has been like this almost every single day for the entire eight months without any break.
Have you also had low energy, poor sleep, low self-esteem, poor appetite, or trouble concentrating during this time?
To be honest, I haven't really noticed any changes in my sleep, appetite, or energy levels. I also don't think I've had issues with concentration or my self-esteem during this time.
Have you had this depressed mood for at least two years, with symptoms present more days than not?
No, I haven't had this feeling for two years. It has only been going on for about eight months now.
Have you had this depressed mood for at least two years, with symptoms present more days than not?
No, it hasn't been two years at all. It has only been about eight months since this heavy, empty feeling started.
Have you had this depressed mood for at least two years, with symptoms present more days than not?
No, it definitely hasn't been two years. It has only been ongoing for about eight months now.
Have you had any loss of interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy during these eight months?

Yes, I've completely lost interest in all the hobbies and activities I used to love. I just can't seem to feel any happiness or pleasure from anything anymore. It has been like that for the entire eight months.
Have you had any periods of at least two months during these eight months when your mood felt back to normal?
No, I haven't had any periods like that at all. My mood has been consistently low and depressed for the entire eight months without any break or feeling back to normal.
Have you had any loss of interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy during these eight months?
Yes, I really don't care about any of my hobbies or activities anymore. I just feel completely empty and can't find any joy or pleasure in anything. It has been like that for the whole eight months.
Have you had any loss of interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy during these eight months?
Yes, I have. Over these past eight months, I've completely lost interest in all the hobbies and activities I used to enjoy. I just can't feel any happiness or pleasure from anything anymore.
